artifact.summary: Qiskit operation for the phase-gate distribution stage of generalized Kitaev phase estimation. On M probe qubits (qubit j = Qiskit index j), n_j copies of the single-qubit phase gate P(phi) are applied, so qubit j acquires phase n_j*phi, with N = sum n_j. The default distribution is the standard Kitaev n_j = 2^j, and arbitrary non-negative integer counts are accepted. Input product-state preparation (e.g. |+>), measurement, the estimator and the error analysis are left to the runner or out of scope.
register_layout: q[0] (Qiskit index 0): probe qubit j=0, receives n_0 phase gates P(phi)
q[1] (index 1): probe qubit j=1, receives n_1 phase gates
q[j] (index j): probe qubit j, receives n_j phase gates; j = 0..M-1, M<=12
Encoding: computational basis; |1> of qubit j picks up phase exp(i*n_j*phi) relative to |0>. Runner is expected to prepare |+> on each qubit.
No ancilla qubits; total qubits = M

equation_mapping.explanation: Scaling claim (MSE ~ 1/N) for the standard algorithm; it is a statistical statement, not a circuit. The default gate_counts n_j=2^j in build_circuit only reproduces the standard gate distribution, not the error scaling.

Heisenberg 1/N^2 scaling depends on the optimal distribution, estimator and error analysis, none of which are given in the abstract. The circuit accepts arbitrary gate_counts but does not implement the optimal choice or the scaling.
MSE definition is classical post-processing/evaluation and involves measurement and an estimator, which are excluded from the operation.

specification_changes.change: Scope narrowed to the unitary phase-gate distribution stage: n_j copies of P(phi) on qubit j with caller-supplied (or default 2^j) counts.
specification_changes.reason: The equations are scaling statements about estimation error; only the gate distribution is expressible as a circuit operation. The optimal distribution is not given in the abstract.

specification_changes.change: Measurement, estimator, and error computation are omitted.
specification_changes.reason: The operation must be measurement-free and contain no state preparation or sampling; these are performed by the runner.

specification_changes.change: Each phase gate is taken to be P(phi)=diag(1,e^{i phi}) acting on one qubit, applied repeatedly rather than merged into P(n_j*phi).
specification_changes.reason: The abstract does not define the gate; this is the standard Kitaev form and matches counting N as the number of gate uses.

assumptions: Phase gate is P(phi)=diag(1,exp(i*phi)) on a single probe qubit.
Each qubit j receives n_j gates with N = sum n_j; default n_j = 2^j (standard Kitaev) when gate_counts is omitted.
Input state is a product state such as |+>^M prepared externally by the runner.
Total gate number is capped at 4096 and qubits at 12 for safety.
unresolved_issues: Optimal gate distribution for the generalized algorithm is not specified in the abstract.
Loss model, Bayesian bound formula and alternative resource quantification are not specified and not implemented.
Measurement basis and estimator are not part of the operation and remain unspecified.

validation.detail: Circuit built and transpiled successfully; no independent correctness reference selected.
